tagline: A mountain road with walking trails beyond the pavement.
intro: Along SC 107, Falling Waters runs north toward the North Carolina line, with a connecting branch across to SC 130. The Foothills Trail meets the highway at Sloan Bridge, five and a half miles by foot from Upper Whitewater Falls.

The waterfall is a separate excursion across the state line. Viewing platforms stand at different heights, and the trail passes through its base. The other way from Sloan Bridge, past Fish Hatchery Road, the trail descends into the Chattooga River gorge.

moments.title: Sloan Bridge
moments.text: At SC 107, the Foothills Trail reaches Sloan Bridge, a trailhead between Upper Whitewater Falls and the Chattooga River gorge.

moments.title: Upper Whitewater Falls
moments.text: Beyond the state line in North Carolina, viewing platforms look onto the falls from different heights.
